title: Topic 2.3: King Solomon the wise ruler

pages.lesson:
LESSON: KING SOLOMON THE WISE RULER

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.3: King Solomon the wise ruler

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about King Solomon the wise ruler. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How did Solomon demonstrate wisdom in his judgement?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. apply lessons learnt from the story of King Solomon in daily life

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. apply lessons learnt from the story of King Solomon in daily life
   In simple words: practise until you can apply lessons learnt from the story of King Solomon in daily life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about King Solomon the wise ruler using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about King Solomon the wise ruler in the examples.
2. Explain King Solomon the wise ruler to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand King Solomon the wise ruler.
4. Show that you can: apply lessons learnt from the story of King Solomon in daily life

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about King Solomon the wise ruler using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is King Solomon the wise ruler important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss how they solve disputes in class,
2. In turns, read 1Kings 3:16-28 and retell the story of King Solomon,
3. List lessons learnt from the story of King Solomon,
4. Read Proverbs 9:10 and share with classmates what they have learnt,
5. Communication and Collaboration: the skills of listening, speaking and teamwork are enhanced as learners discuss how they solve disputes in class.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. apply lessons learnt from the story of King Solomon in daily life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
